title: Husband, unsure of the time: room tilting, two of his wife's face, lists to one side

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is your emergency? What's the address?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's 1550 Funston Avenue. My husband, Roy, something's off with him, I'm not sure what.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Tell me exactly what you're seeing.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He says the whole room is tilting, he can't stand up without hanging on to the counter, and when he looks at me he says there's two of me, one on top of the other.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He leans hard to one side, like he's on a boat. He nearly went into the fridge.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was he last completely normal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I don't know exactly. Maybe forty minutes? No, wait. The six o'clock news had just started, he was fine then, he was making a joke about the weatherman.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: How old is he, and does he take any blood thinners?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He's 77. He takes Pradaxa for his heart rhythm.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Have him sit or lie down.
